page.layout: One printed page, all lines centred. Title block at top; below it a woodcut ornament; below that the imprint (place, printer, date).
page.notes: Woodcut ornament between the editor line and the imprint: a central cherub's head within scrolled foliage, with swags and pendant tassels below. No text in it. Handwritten "2" in pencil at the top right corner is not printed and is left out. Show-through from the reverse is faint and left out. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is printed.
